title: Issabel PBX Hard-Coded JWT Key Could Allow Admin Access
content_md:
Issabel PBX had a hard-coded JWT key that could let attackers forge admin tokens and gain access to PBX functions. Tracked as CVE-2026-89026, the issue has now been patched by moving the key into the system configuration submitted by /u/thechougala [link] [comments]

via reddit r/cybersecurity: Issabel PBX Hard-Coded JWT Key Could Allow Admin Access

CVE-2026-89026.evidence: Event reports hard-coded key enabling forged admin tokens; no observed in-the-wild exploitation claimed, only patch release.
